weather_report:
In the hushed hours just before dawn, Boston rests under a quilt of soft clouds, hinting at the rain that will soon envelop the city. As the night lingers on, the temperature drapes itself around the low forties, while a gentle breeze stirs from the south, bringing with it a promise of moisture. On the morrow, the atmosphere shifts dramatically as rain showers will cascade between ten in the morning and five in the evening, painting the landscape with a glistening sheen. The high will hover in the low sixties, suggesting a cooldown against the remnants of summer. That 100% chance of precipitation indicates a day best spent indoors, with only the brave venturing into the misty embrace of the outdoors.

As one prepares to meet the day, layering becomes essential. A light, water-resistant jacket paired with comfortable trousers would guard against the chill and moisture, ensuring warmth without sacrificing comfort. Perhaps take this time to delve into a good book at a cozy café, where the scent of freshly brewed coffee mingles with the sound of soft conversation. Alternatively, an afternoon at a local museum can provide both refuge from the elements and a flavorful taste of culture, igniting the spirit while the rains dance outside.
